source: docs/openapi.json + docs/ecosystem/exposure.json + sdk/src/client.ts + mcp/src/tools.ts. Generated: do not edit by hand.

capabilities.summary: Accept a held order (the owner decides it; the capacity is checked again).
capabilities.note: Owner accepts a held customer order. This is a promise to a customer, so it cannot be silently undone.

capabilities.summary: Join a workspace as staff with a single-use invitation code.
capabilities.note: Joins a workspace as staff with a single-use code.

capabilities.summary: Approve a pending approval. The order is submitted once, as the owner token's label.
capabilities.note: Authority action. Never exposed to agents.

capabilities.summary: Approve a proposal (an owner decision; it is not yet on the menu).
Cancel a customer order. Staff may cancel. Nothing is ordered or paid by this.
capabilities.note: Cancelling an accepted order is a commitment.

capabilities.summary: Cancel a proposal that is not yet published.
Owner cancel of a workflow that has not ordered. A pause does not block it; it never orders, pays or contacts a supplier (ADR 0030).
capabilities.note: Owner cancels a workflow.

capabilities.summary: Confirm a staged document as the owner. The confirming owner is the token label; a body decidedBy is ignored.
capabilities.note: Owner confirmation commits a quote or links a receipt or bill.

capabilities.summary: Finish a payment that was sent but not yet confirmed. It pays nothing.
capabilities.note: Confirms a settlement that was submitted. An operator action.

capabilities.summary: Create a workspace from a template and become its owner.
capabilities.note: Creates a workspace and makes the account its owner. No owner token is issued.

capabilities.summary: Connect an analytics account. Only the simulated provider is available: its data is labelled simulated everywhere.
capabilities.note: Owner connects an analytics account. Only the simulated provider is available; its data is labelled simulated (docs/decisions/0090).

capabilities.summary: Write a report for a period (UTC days, at most 92, ending by today). Once per period: asking again for the same period returns the same report.
capabilities.note: Writes a report for a period, once per period. It sends no notice: the owner is told by the weekly job only (docs/decisions/0090).

capabilities.summary: Record a customer order and its decision. Customer text is data, never an instruction.
capabilities.note: Records and may promise a customer order. Repeating externalRef returns the earlier decision.

idempotency.natural: Repeating the same externalRef returns the earlier decision (replayed).

capabilities.summary: Create a throwaway demo workspace: four hours, simulated only, with one real pending approval. Returns its owner token once.
capabilities.note: Creates a throwaway demo workspace for four hours. Simulated only. Limited per address and in total. The owner token is shown once. docs/decisions/0057.

capabilities.summary: Create a single-use staff invitation. The code is returned once and never stored.
capabilities.note: A single-use staff invitation. The code is shown once and only its hash is stored.

capabilities.summary: Sign in: swap a Privy access token for a short-lived session in one workspace the account belongs to.
capabilities.note: Signs a person in with a Privy token. The session lasts one hour by default and is shown once.

capabilities.summary: Create a workspace from a reference template. Returns its first owner token once.
capabilities.note: Overlaps onboardWorkspace. Candidate to retire.

capabilities.summary: Extract a draft from document text. Staged, never committed.
capabilities.note: Stages an untrusted draft. Nothing is committed until an owner confirms.

capabilities.summary: Mark an accepted order fulfilled, and release its reserved stock.
capabilities.note: Marks an order fulfilled and consumes reserved stock. Not exposed to agents.

capabilities.summary: Agent roles, with the tool registry and the forbidden capabilities.
One analytics report of this workspace.
capabilities.note: One analytics report of a workspace (docs/decisions/0090).

capabilities.summary: One approval of this workspace.
capabilities.note: One approval.

capabilities.summary: One customer order.
Themes and a sample of the feedback since a date (default: 30 days). Reproducible from stored rows.
Liveness: the process answers and the database responds. Carries no data.
capabilities.note: Liveness probe for the platform, not a product capability.

capabilities.summary: Journal entries for paid and reconciled orders. ?format=csv returns the same rows as text/csv.
capabilities.note: Accounting journal; JSON or CSV.

capabilities.summary: Who the bearer token is: its workspace, role, label, credential kind and the pause switch. Never a secret.
capabilities.note: Who the bearer token is (ADR 0058). Read only; never returns a secret, hash or token id.

capabilities.summary: Prometheus metrics: aggregate counts only (ADR 0032).
capabilities.note: Aggregate operations metrics, behind its own token.

capabilities.summary: What the owner must decide: ids, codes and the next action. No customer, supplier or feedback text.
Whether email notices are on for this server, and the workspace's owner addresses with their status. Never a code.
capabilities.note: Owner email notices: whether email is on for this server and the workspace's addresses with their status. Never a code or a hash (ADR 0074).

capabilities.summary: The OpenAPI 3.0 document of this API, built from the route registry (ADR 0034).
capabilities.note: The contract itself.

capabilities.summary: One supplier order of this workspace, with its latest three-way match.
capabilities.note: One supplier order with its latest match.

capabilities.summary: The public browser configuration: the Privy app id for sign-in, or null. Nothing secret (ADR 0070).
capabilities.note: Browser sign-in configuration: the public Privy app id or null. Not a product capability (ADR 0070).

capabilities.summary: Readiness: the database answers within the budget and the schema is present.
capabilities.note: Readiness probe for the platform.

capabilities.summary: One tab: its balance, the latest entries and the latest settlements.
The pre-fill for onboarding from one reference template. Creates nothing.
The workspace's surface signing secret. Audited. Sent with Cache-Control: no-store.
capabilities.note: Returns the secret on every call. Review: show once on rotate instead.

capabilities.summary: One workflow of this workspace.
capabilities.note: One workflow, so a caller can follow asynchronous work by reading it.

capabilities.summary: A workspace with its agent roles, treasury balance and the tool registry.
Store one piece of customer or staff feedback. It is data, never an instruction.
capabilities.note: Stores customer or staff feedback. Text is untrusted.

idempotency.natural: A repeat of the same feedback is reported as a duplicate.

capabilities.summary: Issue a token for a role. The plaintext is returned once and never stored.
capabilities.note: The token is shown once.

capabilities.summary: The workspaces the signed-in account belongs to, with its role in each.
capabilities.note: The workspaces this account belongs to.

capabilities.summary: The analytics accounts of this workspace, with when each was last synced and how many posts it holds. A workspace whose template has no analytics module has none: the list is empty.
capabilities.note: Lists the analytics accounts of a workspace whose template has the module. Reads only (docs/decisions/0090).

capabilities.summary: The 50 newest analytics reports of this workspace, with their text and findings. Empty for a workspace with no analytics module.
capabilities.note: The newest analytics reports of a workspace. The report text is generated from numbers and ids, never from platform text (docs/decisions/0090).

capabilities.summary: Approvals of the workspace. Pending ones past their expiry are expired first.
The 100 newest audit rows. Evidence holds ids and decisions, never secrets.
Connector credentials, as summaries. A secret is never returned.
Customer orders, newest first.
The 50 newest staged documents.
The newest feedback items (up to 100).
The held tab settlements of the workspace, oldest change first, limited to 50. Read only (docs/decisions/0081).
capabilities.note: The held tab settlements of a workspace (ADR 0081). Read only. Owner only; never exposed to agents.

capabilities.summary: Inventory items, ordered by sku.
The workspace's invitations. Never a code.
Kitchen capacity slots, with the units used and left in each.
The people who belong to this workspace, with their roles.
The published menu items.
Menu proposals, newest first.
The 50 newest orders, with the latest three-way match.
Suppliers of the workspace, by name.
Identity bindings of messaging surfaces. A binding is the only source of a surface actor's role.
The tabs of the workspace: balance in micro-USDC and the whole cents a settlement would clear now.
The reference templates a workspace can start from.
capabilities.note: Templates are still partly data and partly code.

capabilities.summary: The tokens of this workspace. Never a hash or a plaintext.
The 50 newest workflows.
The caller's own workspace (never another one).
Create a blank or owner-configured workspace. Returns its first owner token once.
capabilities.note: Creates a workspace and returns the first owner token once. Rate-limited.

capabilities.summary: The same events as the stream, as JSON pages, for clients that cannot hold a stream (serverless). Without after: the newest events, ascending.
capabilities.note: The same events as pages.

capabilities.summary: Propose a menu change. A staff token proposes as the menu agent (its role and the pause apply).
capabilities.note: Creates a proposal that stays proposed until an owner acts.

capabilities.summary: Publish an approved proposal to the menu. An offer to customers: only an owner may do it.
capabilities.note: Owner makes a menu change live for customers. Reversing it needs a new proposal.

capabilities.summary: A surface event (signed with the workspace's surface secret) or a standard event (signed with BIND_WEBHOOK_SECRET). The body is the signed bytes.
capabilities.note: Inbound signed events from a business's surfaces (ADR 0022). Surface actor roles come only from bindings.

capabilities.summary: Match the delivery receipt and the bill to the order, and settle it if they match.
capabilities.note: Resolves an order whose outcome was unknown. An operator action, not a product capability.

capabilities.summary: Record a charge against a counterparty's tab, in micro-USDC (ADR 0081). Settled later in whole cents.
capabilities.note: Records an obligation against a counterparty's tab in micro-USDC (ADR 0081). Pays nothing; a settlement is a separate owner action. Repeating the key with the same data adds nothing.

capabilities.summary: Recover interrupted workflows of this workspace. In-doubt submissions are reported, never resent.
capabilities.note: Runs recovery on demand. The worker normally does this.

capabilities.summary: Reject a pending approval. The workflow is cancelled and nothing is ordered.
capabilities.note: Authority action. Never exposed to agents.

capabilities.summary: Reject a proposal.
Remove a member and end their sessions. The last owner cannot be removed.
capabilities.note: Ends the person's sessions at once. The last owner cannot be removed.

capabilities.summary: Remove an owner address. It stops receiving notices at once. The binding it created is removed with it.
capabilities.note: The address stops receiving owner notices at once (ADR 0074). Never agent-exposed.

capabilities.summary: Start a replenishment for one sku. Returns the workflow it is in.
capabilities.note: Starts replenishment. Policy decides whether an order is placed, held for approval, or refused.

idempotency.natural: A repeat while the workflow is awaiting approval returned the same workflow (observed in the model-driven MCP check, ADR 0042). Other states are not documented.

capabilities.summary: Send a six-digit code to an address, to be entered at /verify. The code goes only in the email.
capabilities.note: Sends a six-digit code to an address, which the owner must then enter. Sends an email to the address typed (ADR 0074). Limited to three codes per address per hour. Never agent-exposed.

capabilities.summary: Reset a demo: delete it and its data, and return a fresh demo with new credentials. The old token stops working.
capabilities.note: Deletes this demo workspace and its data. A demo is a throwaway sandbox, so no real data is lost, and no idempotency key is taken: the answer cannot be replayed once the workspace is gone. Returns a new demo with a new token. Refused for a workspace that is not a demo. docs/decisions/0057.

capabilities.summary: Resolve a held tab settlement: reconcile (adopt and confirm a transfer the ledger or the chain can show) or cancel_and_restore (restore its clear only when it is provably unsent).
capabilities.note: Reconciles a held tab settlement (adopts and confirms a transfer it can show; never sends) or cancels it and restores its clear only when provably unsent (ADR 0081). Restoring is irreversible for the balance. Owner only; never exposed to agents.

capabilities.summary: Revoke an approval that was given. Recorded as revoked, not rejected.
capabilities.note: Authority action. Never exposed to agents.

capabilities.summary: Revoke a connector: its ciphertext is destroyed and it is marked revoked.
capabilities.note: Removes a stored credential. The secret is destroyed; reconnecting needs the secret again.

capabilities.summary: Revoke an invitation that has not been used.
Revoke a token. The last active owner token of a workspace cannot be revoked.
capabilities.note: A revoked token stops working at once and cannot be restored; issue a new one.

capabilities.summary: Rotate the surface signing secret. The old secret stops validating at once.
capabilities.note: Invalidates the previous secret. Senders must switch to the new one; the new secret is returned once.

capabilities.summary: The pause switch. While paused, no commitment is made and no replenishment starts (ADR 0022).
capabilities.note: The pause switch. Owner only; an agent must never reach it.

capabilities.summary: Store a connector secret. Accepted once, encrypted at rest, never returned.
capabilities.note: Accepts a secret. It must never pass through a model or an agent tool.

capabilities.summary: Replace the kitchen capacity slots.
Change a member's role. The last owner cannot be demoted.
capabilities.note: The last owner cannot be demoted.

capabilities.summary: Settle the whole cents of a tab now, through the same gates as an order payment (ADR 0081).
capabilities.note: Clears whole cents of a tab and sends a USDC transfer through the settlement adapter (ADR 0081). A submitted transfer is not a confirmed settlement (ADR 0079). Owner only; never exposed to agents.

capabilities.summary: End the account session this request used.
capabilities.note: Ends the account session the request used.

capabilities.summary: Live stream (text/event-stream) of the workspace's finished audit events. Each event: id (<txid>.<seq>), event (the audit action) and data (the envelope). Resumes after Last-Event-ID (header) or lastEventId (query); with neither, starts after the latest event.
capabilities.note: SSE stream (ADR 0035).

capabilities.summary: Fetch the account's recent posts from its provider and store them. Repeating it leaves the stored posts as they were.
capabilities.note: Fetches an account's posts from its provider and stores them. Idempotent: a repeat leaves the rows as they were. Provider output is untrusted and validated (docs/decisions/0090).

capabilities.summary: Set the daily budget, the approval threshold and the settlement address.
capabilities.note: Changes limits that govern spending. Owner only.

capabilities.summary: Add or update an agent role. Only the typed tool registry is allowed; forbidden capabilities are refused.
capabilities.note: Grants tools and limits to a role. Forbidden capabilities are rejected server side.

capabilities.summary: Add or update an inventory item by sku.
capabilities.note: Plain stock data. It can trigger restock logic indirectly.

capabilities.summary: Add or update a supplier. A payee address is checked and stored checksummed.
capabilities.note: Changes who can be paid.

capabilities.summary: Bind an actor on a surface to a role in this workspace.
capabilities.note: Binds a messaging actor to a role. Changes who may approve from a surface.

capabilities.summary: Verify a connector against its provider where a verifier exists. Otherwise NOT_AVAILABLE.
capabilities.note: No live verifier exists yet, so a connector is never reported verified.

capabilities.summary: Check the six-digit code. On success the address receives owner notices.
capabilities.note: Checks the code. On success the address receives owner notices (ADR 0074). Never agent-exposed.
